entities.summary: Taizo Mikazuki (b. 1971-05-24, Kyoto Prefecture) was a civil rights leader or advocate of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kyoto Prefecture and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, labor organizers, asia.
